exclusion_detail: Lead 23 needs at least 7 reactions: transesterification of methyl benzilate with N-Boc-4-hydroxypiperidine, Boc removal (1), N-acylation with 1-chloroethyl chloroformate (2), Ag2O coupling with a Boc-tert-leucine, Boc removal (amine 18), HATU coupling with di-Boc-lysine (23i), TFA deprotection (23).
notes: Only the intermediates 1 (2 steps) and 2 (3 steps) have explicit routes of 4 steps or fewer; every amino acid prodrug (3-28) needs 5 or more. Count taken from Schemes 1-3 and the experimental section of the main article; no SI file.
